blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In the literature, autoformalization is broadly defined as the task of automatically generating statements in a target formalism that capture the semantics of a Natural Language (NL) sentence Szegedy (2020) ; Mensfelt et al. (2026) ; Wu et al. (2022) . Although NL is well-suited for everyday human communication, its flexibility, expressiveness, and inherent ambiguity make it ill-suited for interaction with automated reasoning tools, which require inputs to be unambiguous and specified within a formal semantic framework. Early work relied on rule-based systems Kamath and Das (2018) and controlled natural languages Kuhn (2014) , while more recent approaches have adopted neural network-based methods Jiang and Cai (2024) .
Despite the considerable research effort devoted to autoformalization, the field still lacks a unified formulation and a systematic survey when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism. Here, we address this gap.

尽管在自动化方面做出了相当大的研究努力,但当第一命令逻辑(FOL)被视为目标形式主义时,该领域仍然缺乏统一的表述和系统的调查. 在这里,我们处理这一差距。

blocks.en:
The motivations are threefold.
First, Large Language Models (LLMs) have reshaped the autoformalization research landscape: their flexibility and general-purpose linguistic competence make autoformalization feasible across a wide range of domains Mensfelt et al. (2026) .
Second, no systematic survey of LLM-based autoformalization for FOL currently exists, despite FOL offering a well-established balance between expressive power and algorithmic tractability. Surveys for other formalisms, such as Linear Temporal Logic Germiniani et al. (2025) and SQL Mohammadjafari et al. (2024) , already play a pivotal role in their respective landscapes.
Third, autoformalization underpins a wide range of relevant applications. In reasoning tasks, symbolic methods such as theorem provers and Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solvers are reliable and explainable, but require inputs in a precise logical format; autoformalization is thus crucial for converting NL task instances into appropriate representations. Recent work shows that inserting a formalization step and invoking symbolic tools can outperform directly prompting an LLM to solve multi-step logical reasoning problems Ye et al. (2023) ; Olausson et al. (2023) ; Pan et al. (2023) ; Callewaert et al. (2025) , with FOL yielding the best performance in certain settings Beiser et al. (2025) . Beyond reasoning, reliable formalization tools could make formal verification accessible to non-experts and enable scalable verification of large text corpora, an especially important prospect for AI safety approaches that regard formal guarantees as essential Dalrymple et al. (2024) . The significance of autoformalization in FOL has also been demonstrated in logical fallacy detection Lalwani et al. (2024) , argumentation mining Sun et al. (2025) , legal reasoning Alam et al. (2023) , and anomaly detection Jin et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: 2 Autoformalization Definition
blocks.zh: 2 自动正规化定义

blocks.en: Despite a growing body of work on FOL-autoformalization—both as an engineering component and as a task of independent interest—the field lacks a shared, precise formulation of what the task requires. Informal descriptions typically present autoformalization as the translation of a NL text into a FOL formula that preserves its semantic content. This formulation is ambiguous: it leaves open what formal machinery the formula is interpreted over, and it does not specify under what conditions a formula counts as correct or faithful.
blocks.zh: 尽管关于FOL-自动正规化的工作越来越多——既作为一个工程部分,又作为一个独立感兴趣的任务——但该领域缺乏对任务要求的共同、准确的表述。 非正式描述一般将自动形式化作为将NL文本翻译为保留其语义内容的FOL公式. 这一提法含糊不清:它没有打开解释公式的正式机制,也没有具体说明公式在什么条件下算正确或忠实。

blocks.en: 3 Autoformalization Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 自动正规化评价

blocks.en: Here we explore the datasets and metrics used in the literature for evaluation, deferring their use in performance-enhancement methods to Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 在此,我们探讨评价文献中使用的数据集和衡量标准,将其用于提高业绩的方法推迟到第4节。

blocks.en:
In principle, evaluation should assess both the quality of the ontology and that of the resulting FOL formula. In practice, no existing work explicitly evaluates signature quality, even when the OE/LT decomposition is acknowledged—a gap shared with ontology learning, where evaluation is also conducted indirectly via downstream tasks Du et al. (2024) . In FOL-autoformalization, signature quality is therefore assessed only implicitly: a correct formula is taken as evidence that the employed symbols constitute an adequate signature. Similarly for the theory, that is considered by only a small portion of the FOL-autoformalization literature Lalwani et al. (2024) ; Callewaert et al. (2025) , and substantially overlaps with the field of ontology learning and commonsense knowledge acquisition Armary et al. (2025) ; Du et al. (2024) , which have their own methods and evaluation frameworks.
Accordingly, we focus on the evaluation of FOL formulas: this can be done either directly or via proxy tasks.
blocks.zh:
原则上,评价应评估本体学的质量以及由此产生的FOL公式的质量。 在实践中,即使承认OE/LT分解,现有工作也没有明确评价签字质量——这是与肿瘤学学习共同存在的一个差距,通过下游任务Du等人(2024年)间接进行评价。 因此,在FOL-自动形式化中,只隐含地评估签名质量:采用正确的公式作为使用符号构成适当签名的证据。 与此相类似,该理论仅被FOL-自动正规化文献Lalwani等人(2024年)所考虑;Callewaert等人(2025年),并在很大程度上与本体学学习和常识获取Armery等人(2025年)相重叠;Du等人(2024年),他们有自己的方法和评价框架.
因此,我们侧重于评估财务业务保障模式:可以直接或通过代理任务做到这一点。

blocks.en: A fundamental challenge is the cost of obtaining ground-truth formulas: correct FOL annotations require significant expertise, making large-scale direct evaluation often prohibitive. Proxy tasks offer a practical alternative, measuring whether the formalization succeeds at a downstream application rather than against a ground truth. Any application can serve this role, provided formalization success is clearly reflected in the overall outcome; for example, Lalwani et al. (2024) use formalization for logical fallacy detection, while Karia et al. (2024) formalize a NL sentence back from a FOL formula and checks equivalence with the original.
blocks.zh: 一项基本挑战是获得地面真实公式的费用:正确的财务业务说明需要大量专门知识,因此大规模直接评价往往令人望而却步。 代理任务提供了一个实用的可选方案,衡量形式化是否在下游应用中成功,而不是与地面真理相对. 任何应用都可以发挥这一作用,只要形式化的成功在总体结果中得到明确反映;例如,Lalwani等人(2024年)使用形式化来进行逻辑谬误检测,而Karia等人(2024年)则将NL句从FOL公式中正规化并检查与原句的等同.

blocks.en:
In practice, though, most of the literature uses Natural Language Inference (NLI) task as a proxy. In NLI, given premises p 1 , … , p n p_{1},\dots,p_{n} and a conclusion c c , the task is to determine whether c c is logically entailed by the premises. This entailment relation should be preserved under formalization: if p 1 , … , p n , c p_{1},\dots,p_{n},c are formalized as φ 1 , … , φ n , ψ \varphi_{1},\dots,\varphi_{n},\psi , then c c is entailed by (resp., contradicts) the premises p 1 , … , p n p_{1},\dots,p_{n} if and only if ψ \psi (resp., ¬ ψ \neg\psi ) is derivable from the premises φ 1 , … , φ n \varphi_{1},\dots,\varphi_{n} .
This methodology has well-known limitations Brunello et al. (2026b) : entailment agreement between NL and FOL can occur even with incorrect formulas; a mismatch can arise from any subset of incorrectly formalized sentences; and NL entailment may rely on background knowledge not captured by the formalization. 2 2 2 Some limitations can be mitigated by generating multiple conclusions depending on different premise subsets, or by using datasets that do not require background knowledge.

这种方法有众所周知的局限性 Brunello等 (2026b):即使公式不正确,NL和FOL之间也可能发生内置协议;任何子集不正确形式化的句子都可能产生不匹配;而NL内置可能依赖于形式化所没有获得的背景知识. 2个 2,一些局限性可以通过根据不同前提子集生成多个结论来缓解,或者通过使用不需要背景知识的数据集来缓解.

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We review how existing datasets pairing a NL sentence to a FOL formula (NL–FOL) are constructed and validated. We discuss FOLIO Han et al. (2024) , Willow Deveci (2024) , MALLS Yang et al. (2024) , ProverQA Qi et al. (2025) , PROOFFOL Thatikonda et al. (2024) , Text2log Levkovskyi and Li (2021) , and the private (but available on request) Grade Grinder Corpus (GGC) Barker-Plummer et al. (2011a) . A high-level summary is provided in Table 1 .
Purely NLI datasets without a validated FOL layer are excluded from the main body of the paper, as they are not directly usable for autoformalization evaluation. Further information about these datasets, and what would need to be supplied to make them usable for the autoformalization task, is provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Three main generation paradigms recur across the considered datasets, often in combination: human generation , LLM generation , and rule-based generation . Despite some of the procedures provide a degree of validation per se (e.g., human generation), they are sometimes complemented with additional checks.
blocks.zh: 三个主要的生成模式在考虑的数据集中反复出现,常常是组合的:人类生成、LLM生成和规则生成。 尽管有些程序本身提供了某种程度的验证(例如人类的世代),但有时会辅以额外的检查.

blocks.en:
Human generation is used for FOLIO and for the GGC corpus. FOLIO
is a NLI dataset consisting of ∼ 500 \sim 500 different stories with a total of ∼ 2400 \sim 2400 premises and ∼ 1400 \sim 1400 conclusions, written in NL and then formalized to FOL by experts. A first-order theorem prover is used to check whether the entailments are preserved by the FOL formalization, filtering out the instances in which a mismatch occurs.
GGC collects students’ FOL submissions in response to Tarski’s World exercises from the textbook Language, Proof and Logic Barker-Plummer et al. (2011b) , labelled using an automatic grading tool that enforces syntactic and semantic coherence.
blocks.zh:
人类世代用于FOLIO和GGC体. 美国
是一个NLI数据集,由\ 500\sim 500不同的故事组成,总计有\ 24\sim 2400的会所和\ 1400\sim 1400的结论,用NL写成,然后由专家正式提交FOL。 使用一等定理验证器来检查是否通过FOL正规化来保存所包含内容,从而过滤出出现错配的情况.
GGC收集学生针对塔尔斯基的世界练习而提交的FOL材料,来自教科书"语言"(Language, Profof and Logic Barker-Plummer et al.(2011b)),标签使用自动分级工具,强制进行协同和语义一致性.

blocks.en:
LLM generation underlies Willow, MALLS, PROOFFOL, and the NL side of ProverQA. Willow extends ∼ 300 \sim 300 human-validated NL–FOL pairs to 16K using GPT - 4, discarding outputs that fail a grammar check; NL–FOL alignment is only partially verified.
MALLS collects 28K NL–FOL pairs by prompting GPT-4 to generate NL sentences and then to formalize them using a dynamic n n -gram counter to encourage diversity. In addition, a human-checked subset of 1K examples is used to identify frequent errors, which are then targeted by rule-based filters to remove such mistakes from the remaining dataset. PROOFFOL uses GPT - 4o to formalize the premises and conclusions of ProofWriter Tafjord et al. (2021) , retaining only instances where the theorem prover’s verdict matches the source dataset’s ground truth, thereby enforcing both syntactic well-formedness and label consistency.
ProverQA inverts the direction: an LLM generates NL stories with human-interpretable meanings for predicate symbols, while the FOL side is produced by a symbolic generator, guaranteeing logical structure by construction.
blocks.zh:
LLM世代是柳条,MALLS,PROOFFOL以及普罗维尔QA的NL一面的基础. Willow使用 GBT - 4 将 ^ 300\sim 300 人类验证的 NL – FOL 配对扩展至 16K , 丢弃未通过语法检查的输出; NL- FOL 校正仅部分核实.
MALLS通过提示GPT-4生成NL句子来收集出28K NL-FOL对子,然后使用动态n-gram计数器将其正规化来鼓励多样性. 此外,还使用由1K实例组成的由人检查的子集来识别频繁出错,然后被基于规则的过滤器瞄准去去除所剩数据集中的此类出错. PROOFFOL使用GPT - 4o将ProofWriter Tafjord等人(2021年)的前提和结论正规化,只保留定理证明人的判决与源数据集的地表真相相匹配的事例,从而强制实施协同性与标签一致性.
ProverQA倒置方向:一个LLM生成NL故事,对上游符号有人可解释的含义,而FOL侧则由符号生成器所出出,通过构造保证了逻辑结构.

blocks.en:
Rule-based generation appears in Text2log and in the symbolic part of ProverQA and, in both cases, most validation is intrinsic to the generator.
Text2log uses predefined grammar rules (through an ad hoc CCG-based semantic parser) to formalize in FOL template-based NL sentences, creating roughly 100K NL–FOL pairs. FOL is correct by construction, but the range of covered NL instances is limited and strongly template-driven.
blocks.zh:
基于规则的生成出现在Text2log和ProverQA的象征部分,在这两种情况下,大多数验证都是生成器所固有的.
Text2log 使用预定义的语法规则(通过一个基于CCG的临时语义解析器)在基于FOL模板的NL句子中正式化,创建了大约100K NL–FOL对. FOL通过构建是正确的,但覆盖的NL实例范围有限并强烈由模板驱动.

blocks.en: The generation and validation choices have direct implications on how each dataset should be used in autoformalization.
blocks.zh: 生成和验证选择对每个数据集如何用于自动形式化有直接影响。

blocks.en: Datasets with expert-written NL and FOL pairs plus solver-based checks, such as FOLIO and the GGC corpus, provide the strongest available basis for evaluation. Despite the human-conducted generation and the solver-based label-consistency tests, several independent analyses Pei et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2024) ; Brunello et al. (2026b) document the presence of annotation errors in FOLIO. In particular, Brunello et al. (2026a) found a high rate of ambiguous and incorrect formalizations in the validation split of FOLIO and in a subset of the MALLS test set; the authors show that these annotation errors can substantially skew reported model performance, and consequently released corrected versions of these datasets for use in evaluating models on this task.
blocks.zh: 由专家撰写的NL和FOL对并加上基于解析器的检查的数据集,如FOLIO和GGC等,为评价提供了最有力的可用基础. 尽管有人类所操控的一代和基于解析器的标签-一致性测试,但有几次独立分析裴等 (2025) ;杨等 (2024) ; Brunello等 (2026b) 记载了FOLIO中存在注释错误. 特别是Brunello等人(2026年a)在FOLIO的验证分出和MALLS测试集的一个子集中发现高比例的模棱两可和不正确的形式化;作者们表明这些注释错误可以实质性地扭曲所报告模型性能,并因此发布了这些数据集的校正版本,用于评价该任务的模型.

blocks.en: Large-scale LLM-generated datasets typically guarantee syntactic well-formedness but do not explicitly validate NL–FOL semantic alignment. Systematic error patterns consequently persist, as acknowledged by the authors of MALLS and Willow and further documented in Brunello et al. (2026b) . A similar consideration applies to rule-based datasets like Text2log, where template-driven NL may not reflect the linguistic variation encountered in realistic settings.
blocks.zh: 大型LLM所生成的数据集一般保证了合成的完善性,但没有明确验证NL-FOL语义对齐. 因此,系统性错误模式继续存在,正如马氏LLS和Willow的作者所承认,并在Brunello等人(2026年b)中作了进一步记录。 类似的考虑也适用于Text2log等基于规则的数据集,其中由模板驱动的NL可能无法反映现实环境中遇到的语言变异.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Semantic Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 语义计量

blocks.en: Semantic metrics evaluate whether a candidate formula φ \varphi and a reference φ ^ \hat{\varphi} convey the same meaning . Direct semantic comparison requires addressing two dimensions in sequence.

blocks.en: Before any semantic comparison can be made, the symbols of φ \varphi must be linked to those of φ ^ \hat{\varphi} —an instance of the anchoring problem Harnad (1999) . Two strategies appear in the literature. The first is syntactic matching : Vossel et al. (2025) use Levenshtein distance Levenshtein (1965) to align predicate symbols across signatures by surface-form similarity, a fragile approach that fails when synonymous concepts receive different names or distinct concepts share one. The second strategy is to provide the signature directly as part of the task input, as in the LT variants. This eliminates the matching problem by construction and is one of the strongest motivations for the OE/LT distinction of Section 2 .

blocks.en: Almost all works implicitly target the raw translation variant, treating autoformalization as a single monolithic step, an approach that has a direct impact on evaluation. Conflicting empirical results in the literature—some works reporting strong LLM performance on NL–FOL translation Yang et al. (2024) , others reporting poor performance Han et al. (2024) —can be traced to heterogeneous evaluation setups arising from different implicit task formulations Brunello et al. (2026b) . The decomposition introduced in Section 2 addresses these inconsistencies and, together with the metric considerations above, motivates a clear recommendation: when direct semantic comparison is needed, since reliable methods for symbol matching across different signatures are currently lacking, the labelled signature should be provided as input—resolving symbol matching by construction—and logical equivalence used as the sole evaluation metric.
blocks.zh: 几乎所有工作都隐含地以原始翻译变体为目标,将自发形式化作为单一的单体步骤,这种方法对评价有直接影响. 文献中相互冲突的经验结果——有些著作报告了NL-FOL翻译杨等人(2024年)的LLM强效性能,而另一些著作则报告了Han等人(2024年)的不良性能——可追溯到不同隐含任务配方(Brunello等人(2026年b))所产生的不同评价结构。 第2节提出的分解处理这些不一致之处,再加上上文的衡量考虑,促使提出明确的建议:在需要直接语义比较时,由于目前缺乏不同签名之间符号相匹配的可靠方法,标有标签的签字应作为输入-解相符号与构造相匹配,逻辑等同性应作为唯一的评价指标。

blocks.en: 4 LLM-based Autoformalization Methods
blocks.zh: 4 LLM 自动化 方法

blocks.en: Since current LLMs can be readily prompted to perform FOL-autoformalization, the research has largely focused on techniques for enhancing their performance. A major distinction can be made between methods that fine-tune the LLM (Section 4.1 ) and those that aim to improve performance without modifying the model’s internal weights, instead relying on prompting strategies (Section 4.2 ) or incorporating a verification stage (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 自目前以来 法学硕士可以随时推动进行FOL-自动正规化,研究主要侧重于提高其性能的技术。 可以对微调LLM(第4.1节)的方法和旨在改进性能而不改变模型内部权重的方法作出重大区分,而是依靠促进战略(第4.2节)或纳入核查阶段(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: Virtually all methods in the FOL-autoformalization literature implicitly target raw translation ( p → φ p\to\varphi ), and OE-specific methods are largely absent from the literature. As discussed in Section 3.2 , no metrics are developed for direct evaluation of a labelled signature’s quality, making it difficult to optimize or compare OE methods in isolation. This represents a structural gap that we discuss further in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: FOL-自动形式化文献中几乎所有方法都隐含地将原始翻译作为目标(p_____p\to\varphi),文献中大多没有OE特定方法. 如第3.2节所讨论,没有制定直接评价标有标记的签字质量的衡量标准,因此很难单独优化或比较OE方法。 这是我们在第五节中进一步讨论的一个结构性差距。

blocks.en: 4.1 Fine-tuning Strategies
blocks.zh: 4.1 微调战略

blocks.en: Fine-tuning consists of taking a pre-trained model that already encodes broad linguistic and world knowledge and specializing it on a task-specific dataset. Various techniques can be applied, ranging from full-parameter updates to parameter-efficient approaches such as Low-Rank Adaptation, and from purely human-annotated corpora to large-scale synthetic resources.
blocks.zh: 微调包括取出一个已经将广泛的语言和世界知识编码的预先训练出的模式,并将其专门用于一个任务特定的数据集. 各种技术可以被应用,从全参数更新到参数效率高的方法,如Low-Rank适应,从纯人性附加说明的蝎子到大规模合成资源.

blocks.en:
The most common strategy updates all model weights, or a subset of them via methods such as Low-Rank Adaptation, using supervised NL–FOL training pairs. Since effective fine-tuning requires a substantial amount of data, most works rely on existing benchmarks. For example, Vossel et al. (2025) combine MALLS and Willow to increase diversity and reduce overfitting, while Xu et al. (2024) augment data through systematic symbol renaming and NL instructions to promote semantic learning over surface memorization.
When existing datasets are insufficient, ad hoc datasets can be constructed synthetically. For instance, Hahn et al. (2022) employ a rule-based pipeline combining established symbolic parsing techniques Clark and Curran (2004) ; Bos (2015) to convert NL sentences into FOL formulas at scale.
blocks.zh:
最常见的策略是通过Low-Rank适应等方法更新所有模型权重,或者其中的一个子集,使用受监督的NL-FOL训练对. 由于有效的微调需要大量数据,所以大多数工作都依赖于现有的基准. 例如,Vossel等人(2025年)将 MALLS 和 Willow 合并,以增加多样性并减少过度配色,而 Xu等人. (2024)通过系统符号重命名和NL指令来增强数据,以在地表记忆之上促进语义学习.
当现有的数据集不足时,可以合成地构建临时数据集. 例如,Hahn等人(2022年)采用了一种基于规则的管道,结合既有的符号解析技术Clark和Curran(2004年);Bos(2015年)将NL句子大规模转换为FOL公式.

blocks.en: Some authors adopt RL in place of, or in addition to, supervised fine-tuning. Yang et al. (2024) train LogicLLAMA using a combination of the BLEU score and the LE score (Section 3.2 ) as a reward function measuring similarity between the candidate translation φ ^ \hat{\varphi} and the ground truth φ \varphi , motivated by the observation that a purely autoregressive fine-tuning objective did not yield optimal performance.
blocks.zh: 一些作者采用RL来代替或补充监督的微调. 杨等 (2024年) 列车 LogicLLAMA 以BLEU分数和LE分数(第3.2节)的组合作为奖励函数,衡量候选翻译 ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ varphi}与地面真理 → \ varphi 之间的相似性,其动机是认为纯自旋性微调目标不能产生最佳性能.

blocks.en: Motivated by strong results in other generative settings, preference optimization methods have also been explored. Lopez-Ponce and Bel-Enguix (2025) propose a Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) procedure starting from FOLIO, where accepted options correspond to ground-truth formalizations and rejected options to LLM-generated alternatives, augmented with quality scores encoding preference strength. 4 4 4 The scores derivation procedure is not fully specified. Viswanadha et al. (2025) further study DPO and KTO (Kahneman–Tversky Optimization), finding that KTO after SFT outperforms both SFT alone and SFT with DPO.
blocks.zh: 受其他基因环境的强大成果的推动,还探索了优化偏好的方法。 Lopez-Ponce和Bel-Enguix(2025年)提出了从FOLIO开始的直接偏好优化(DPO)程序,其中被接受的选项对应地-真实形式化,并拒绝LLM生成的选项,加上质量分数编码偏好强度. 页:1 4 计分程序没有完全规定。 Viswanadha等人(2025年)进一步研究了DPO和KTO(Kahneman-Tversky Optimation),发现SFT之后的KTO单于SFT,而SFT则与DPO同时超越.

blocks.en: 4.2 Prompting Strategies
blocks.zh: 4.2 迅速战略

blocks.en: Multiple prompting strategies have been explored to enhance the capabilities of pre-trained LLMs in autoformalization without modifying their weights.
blocks.zh: 探索了多种激励战略,以提高经过预先培训的有限责任公司在自动正规化方面的能力,而不改变其权重。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Agnostic Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 不可知论 方法

blocks.en: In the autoformalization setting, general-purpose prompting techniques such as Few-Shot prompting , In-Context Learning (ICL), Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Tree-of-Thoughts , and Self-Consistency are commonly used and typically yield performance gains, as shown for instance by Han et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 在自动正规化的设定中,通用的提示技术,如"少Shot protacting","in-Context learning"(ICL),"Cain-of-thought"(CoT),"树-houghts","自相通"(自相通性)被普遍使用并通常产生性能收益,例如由Han等人(2024)所显示.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Task-specific Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 具体任务 方法

blocks.en:
Prompting can also be tailored with task-specific instructions ( meta-prompting ): rather than asking the model to produce a formula directly, the prompt decomposes the task into explicit stages.
For example, Pei et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2025) first instruct the model to identify a suitable labelled signature (i.e., perform OE) and then carry out the LT step. This staged decomposition is precisely the operationalization of the OE/LT distinction, discussed above. Some works further interpose a theory recovery step: Lalwani et al. (2024) ; Nananukul et al. (2025) ; Wen et al. (2025) ask the LLM to select among candidate relational axioms before performing translation. Ryu et al. (2025) decompose the formalization into extracting the logical structure of the sentence, splitting it into simpler components, and performing a sequential translation from subcomponents to the full formula.
blocks.zh:
提示也可以根据特定任务的指示(元快取)量身定制:不要求模型直接出出出一个公式,而由即时分解任务成明确的阶段.
例如,Pei等人(2025年);Hu等人(2025年)首先指示模型识别出合适的有标签的签名(即执行OE),再进行LT步骤. 这一分阶段分解正是上文所讨论OE/LT区分的可操作性。 一些作品进一步干涉了理论恢复步骤:Lalwani等(2024年);Nananukul等(2025年);Wen等(2025年)要求LLM在进行翻译前在候选关系轴中选择. 龙等. (2025)将正文分解为取出句子的逻辑结构,分解为更简单的组件,并进行从子组件到全公式的相继翻译.

blocks.en: Beyond such decompositions, ICL-style methods are also adapted. Hu et al. (2025) use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): a knowledge base of NL–FOL pairs is built from existing datasets and enriched with instances where the model previously failed. Given an input sentence p p , the closest examples in the knowledge base (according to sentence embeddings) are retrieved and inserted into the prompt as contextual demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 除了这种分解外,ICL风格的方法也得到调整. Hu等人(2025年)使用检索增强生成(RAG):从现有数据集中构建了NL-FOL对的知识库,并丰富了该模型以前失败的事例. 鉴于一个输入句p , 获取知识库中最接近的例子( 根据句子嵌入), 并将其作为背景演示插入到提示中 。

blocks.en: 4.3 Output Verification and Refinement Loops
blocks.zh: 4.3 产出核实和完善循环

blocks.en: Feedback-based methods iteratively refine an LLM’s output after an initial formalization attempt. The verification step may rely on formal tools or on the LLM itself, to target either syntactic or semantic correctness.
blocks.zh: 基于反馈的方法在初始形式化尝试后反复地完善LLM的产出. 核查步骤可能依赖正式工具或LLM本身,以瞄准协同或语义正确性。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Syntactic Verification
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 银河核查

blocks.en: The most widely adopted form of verification checks whether the generated formula conforms to the target formalization via a syntax checker or theorem prover. Error messages are fed back into the prompt to localize and correct mistakes Deng et al. (2024) ; Quan et al. (2024) ; some works further augment the prompt with a curated list of common errors and fixes Pan et al. (2023) ; Callewaert et al. (2025) . The loop repeats until a valid formula is produced or an iteration limit is reached.
blocks.zh: 最广泛采用的核查形式是通过语法检查器或定理验证器,核查生成的公式是否符合目标形式化. 错误信息被反馈到Deng等人(2024年);Quan等人(2024年);一些作品通过整理出常见错误清单进一步扩充了该快件,并修正了Pan等人(2023年);Callewaert等人(2025年)。 循环会重复,直到生产出有效的公式或达到迭代限制.

blocks.en: A complementary approach constrains decoding itself, restricting the output vocabulary at each step to tokens that yield a grammatically valid continuation Raspanti et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 一种互补的方法约束了自身编解码,将每个步骤的输出词汇限制在产生语法上有效的续作Raspanti等(2025)的符号上.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Semantic Verification
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 语义核查

blocks.en: Semantic verification is an open challenge. Assessing whether a FOL formula faithfully captures the meaning of a NL sentence requires bridging two fundamentally different representations, which lies beyond the reach of standard theorem provers. Still, formal tools can provide partial semantic feedback: when autoformalizing a corpus of NL sentences into a set of axioms Callewaert et al. (2025) , satisfiability checks can reveal theory-level inconsistencies, and unsatisfiable core extraction can pinpoint offending formulas to guide refinement.
blocks.zh: 语义核查是一个公开的挑战。 评估一个FOL公式是否忠实地抓住了NL句子的含义,需要将两个根本不同的表示进行接通,这超出了标准定理证明人的能及范围. 尽管如此,正式工具还是可以提供部分语义反馈:当将一组NL句子自动形式化成一组动词Callewaert等. (2025年),相容性检查可以揭示出理论层面的不一致,而不可满足的核心取出可以确定违法的公式来指导完善.

blocks.en: For richer semantic feedback, several works turn to LLMs themselves. One line of work generates multiple candidate formalizations and aggregates them via self-consistency and majority voting. Olausson et al. (2023) find that aggregating multiple generations reduces syntactic errors, especially for weaker models, and Brunello et al. (2026b) observe complementary error patterns across model families, motivating ensembling strategies.
blocks.zh: 对于更丰富的语义反馈,多部作品会转向LLMs本身. 一行工作产生多个候选人形式化,通过自我一致和多数投票汇总. Olausson等人(2023年)发现,聚合多代会减少合成错误,尤其是对于较弱的模型,而Brunello等人(2026年b)观察到模型家族之间的互补错误模式,激发了综艺策略.

blocks.en: A second line of work prompts an LLM to directly refine a candidate formalization, like in Brunello et al. (2026a) . To mitigate the fallibility of LLM judges, several strategies have been explored: augmenting the context with a knowledge base of NL–FOL pairs including human-corrected formalizations Hu et al. (2025) ; prompting the model to compare two candidates and select the better one Kirtania et al. (2024) ; and fine-tuning a dedicated verification model on triplets ( p , φ pert , φ ) (p,\varphi_{\text{pert}},\varphi) , where p p is the NL sentence, φ pert \varphi_{\text{pert}} an incorrect (perturbed) formalization, and φ \varphi is the ground truth Thatikonda et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 第二行的工作促使LLM直接完善候选形式化,例如在Brunello等人(2026a)中. 为了减少LLM法官的谬误,已探讨了若干战略:增加NL-FOL对知识库,包括人校正形式化。 Hu等人(2025年);促使模型比较两位候选人并选择更好的一位Kirtania等人(2024年);并微调了三胞胎的专用核查模型(p,- pert,-) (p,\varphi_{\text{pert}},-varphi),其中p为NL句,- pert\varphi_{\text{pert}}为不正确的(被打乱的)正版;-\varphi为Thatikonda等人(2024年)的正版。

blocks.en: Finally, some approaches combine LLM judgment with formal verification. Ryu et al. (2025) iteratively compare pairs of candidate formalizations ( φ , φ ′ ) (\varphi,\varphi^{\prime}) : if they are logically equivalent, one is selected arbitrarily; otherwise an SMT-generated counterexample is passed to the LLM to discriminate between them. Amrollahi et al. (2026) introduce a roundtrip framework where an SMT solver checks equivalence between a formalization and its back-translation, and an LLM judge diagnoses mismatches to guide targeted repair.
blocks.zh: 最后,有些办法将LLM判断与正式核查相结合。 龙等. (2025)迭代比较对候选人形式化的一对(φ,φ) (\varphi,\varphi^{\prime}) : 如果它们在逻辑上是等同的,则任意选择一个;否则,SMT生成的反例被传递给LLM,以区别它们. Amrolahi等人(2026年)引入了圆通框架,由SMT解析器检查形式化与其后翻译的等同性,由LLM法官诊断出不匹配,以指导定向修复.

blocks.en: Drawing strong conclusions aimed at answering "Which is the current best approach to FOL-autoformalization?" is difficult for two compounding reasons: the absence of standardized evaluation protocols (and task definition) makes cross-paper comparisons difficult to achieve, and the annotation noise documented in commonly used benchmarks (Section 3.1 ) further limits the significance of performance differences witnessed when using different solutions.
blocks.zh: 得出旨在回答"当前FOL-自动化的最佳方法是什么"的强烈结论是困难的,原因有两个复杂的原因:没有标准化的评价协议(和任务定义)使得交叉纸面比较难以实现,而常用基准(第3.1节)所记录的注释噪音进一步限制了在使用不同解决方案时所看到的性能差异的意义.

blocks.en:
What is reasonable to conclude is that
frontier reasoning models with simple CoT achieve strong results on the LT task Brunello et al. (2026b) ; fine-tuning smaller models on specific datasets is a viable approach to achieve SOTA performance in a specific context and with less computation (and time) at inference phase. On top of that, prompting techniques (like meta-prompting, decomposing complex sentences into simpler subcomponents, or RAG) can boost the performance of fine-tuned models or already capable ones.
Finally, adding a verification layer on top of any pipeline seems beneficial as well.
While syntactic verification represents a robust enhancement across model families, semantic verification addresses a genuinely different and harder problem, making it essential for reliable autoformalization in practice. SAT solvers offer rigorous but partial feedback Callewaert et al. (2025) ; Amrollahi et al. (2026) , while LLM-based verification can cover the full semantic dimension but lacks formal guarantees and depends heavily on model capability.
blocks.zh:
合理的结论是:
具有简单CoT的边疆推理模型在LT任务Brunello等 (2026b)上取得了很强的结果;在具体数据集上微调更小的模型是在特定背景下实现SOTA性能的可行方法,在推论阶段计算(和时间)较少. 除此之外,导出技术(如元发音,将复杂的句子分解为更简单的子组件,或RAG)可以提升微调模型或已经有能力的模型的性能.
最后,在任何管道上增加一个核查层似乎也是有益的。
虽然综合核查是整个模范家庭的有力增强,但语义核查解决了一个真正不同和更困难的问题,因此在实践中可靠地实现自动化至关重要。 SAT解析器提供严格而部分的反馈 Callewaert 等 (2025); Amrollahi 等 (2026) ;而基于LLM的验证可以涵盖完整的语义维度,但缺乏正式的保证并严重依赖模型能力.

blocks.en: 5 Open Problems and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 5 未决问题和未来方向

blocks.en: We conclude by highlighting open issues in current research and outlining directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们强调当前研究中的未决问题并概述今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: Many evaluation pipelines conflate distinct stages of autoformalization—OE and LT—making it difficult to identify where models struggle. We advocate for standardized evaluation protocols alongside larger, higher-quality benchmarks that are more heterogeneous in domain, formula complexity, and linguistic variation. These benchmarks must also capture overlooked challenges like natural language ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 许多评价管道将自动形式化的不同阶段——OE和LT——混为一谈,使得难以确定模型在哪些地方挣扎。 我们主张标准化评价协议,同时制定更大、质量更高的基准,这些基准在领域、公式复杂性和语言差异方面更为不同。 这些基准还必须包括自然语言模糊等被忽视的挑战。

blocks.en: A work on LTL autoformalization has begun to explore structured intermediate representations Germiniani et al. (2025) ; analogous strategies for FOL remain preliminary Frydman (2025) . A closer exchange of ideas across formalisms—covering intermediates, post-training strategies, and multi-step pipelines—could substantially advance the field. At the methodological level, almost no existing work explicitly targets OE as a standalone task; developing fine-tuning objectives and prompting strategies that adhere to the OE/LT decomposition, and engaging more directly with the ontology learning literature Armary et al. (2025) ; Du et al. (2024) , represents a largely open research agenda.
blocks.zh: 关于LTL自动化的工作已经开始探讨结构化的中间代表Germiniani等人(2025年);FOL的类似战略仍然是Frydman(2025年)的初步战略。 在形式主义——包括中间体、培训后战略和多步骤的管道——之间更密切地交换意见,可以大大地推进该领域。 在方法层面,几乎没有任何现有工作明确将OE作为单独的任务;制定微调目标并激励遵守OE/LT分解的战略,更直接地与肿瘤学学习文献Armary等人(2025年);Du等人(2024年)代表着基本上开放的研究议程。

blocks.en: The connection between autoformalization research and downstream applications—formal verification, legal reasoning, AI safety—remains largely implicit. End-to-end pipelines that reliably formalize corpora of NL specifications are almost entirely absent. Closing this gap is a crucial next step, allowing concrete application requirements to steer the future direction of the research field.
blocks.zh: 自动正规化研究与下游应用之间的联系——正式核查、法律推理、AI安全——基本上仍然隐含着。 可靠地使NL规格公司正规化的端到端管几乎完全不存在. 缩小这一差距是下一个关键步骤,使具体的应用要求能够指导研究领域的未来方向。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This survey does not provide a comparative empirical analysis across enhancement strategies or across LLMs. This is partly by design: as discussed throughout, the absence of standardized evaluation protocols makes cross-paper comparisons unreliable, and one contribution of this work is precisely to clarify the conceptual distinctions—most notably the OE/LT decomposition—that such a standardization would require. By focusing on LLM-based methods, we also set aside earlier symbolic and neural approaches, which are only briefly contextualized in the introduction. Although the surveyed literature evolves rapidly and specific results may become outdated, we believe that the contributions of this work are largely independent of the specific models and datasets available at any given time, and thus retain their value as the landscape continues to develop.
blocks.zh: 这项调查没有提供各种加强战略或各种地方政府的比较经验分析。 其部分原因是设计:正如大家所讨论的那样,没有标准化的评价规程使跨纸比较不可靠,这项工作的一个贡献恰恰是澄清这种标准化所需要的概念区别——最显著的是OE/LT分解。 通过注重基于LLM的方法,我们还搁置了早期的象征和神经方法,这些方法在导言中只是简短的结合. 虽然所调查的文献发展迅速,具体结果可能已经过时,但我们认为,这项工作的贡献在很大程度上独立于任何特定时间可以提供的具体模型和数据集,因此随着地貌的不断发展,它们的价值也得以保留.

blocks.en: To verify the equivalence between two formulas φ \varphi and φ ′ \varphi^{\prime} over the same signature σ \sigma , we employ SMT ( Satisfiability Modulo Theories ) solvers Barrett and Tinelli (2018) . These solvers are highly efficient tools for deciding the satisfiability of first-order formulas; that is, they determine whether, given a first-order formula φ \varphi over a signature σ \sigma as input, there exists a σ \sigma -structure 𝔄 \mathfrak{A} and a variable assignment V V such that 𝔄 V ⊧ φ \mathfrak{A}_{V}\models\varphi .

An SMT solver typically consists of two main components: a Boolean solver that handles the propositional structure of φ \varphi (often based on the DPLL or CDCL algorithms, as in classical SAT solvers) and a theory solver that resolves conjunctions of formulas belonging to a specific theory, such as LRA (Linear Real Arithmetic).
Over the past decades, driven by the remarkable efficiency of SAT solvers, SMT solvers have evolved into powerful tools for automated reasoning, and they now play a crucial role in tasks such as formal verification and planning.

在过去的几十年中,由SAT解析器的显著效率所驱动,SMT解析器已发展成为了自动化推理的强大工具,现在它们在正式核查和规划等任务中起关键作用.

blocks.en:
As explained in Section 3 , NLI datasets can be used to evaluate FOL-autoformalization (via proxy tasks), provided that the reasoning pattern instantiated in each example can be represented in FOL.
However, some of these datasets were developed for other evaluation purposes and therefore need to be supplemented with additional components before they can be used to evaluate FOL-autoformalization. In the following we will briefly discuss the most recent datasets used in the literature.
blocks.zh:
如第3节所解释的,NLI数据集可用于评价FOL-自动形式化(通过代理任务),前提是每个实例中的推理模式可被FOL所代表.
然而,其中一些数据集是为其他评价目的开发的,因此需要补充额外的组件,然后才能用于评价FOL-自动正规化。 下面我们将简要地讨论文献中使用的最新数据集。

blocks.en: Table 2 lists some datasets originally developed to evaluate reasoning in NL, for which no FOL counterpart is available. To make them usable for FOL-autoformalization, an annotator would need to manually formalize the NL sentences that compose each dataset into FOL.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了一些最初为评价NL推理而开发的数据集,没有FOL对应数据. 为使这些数据可用于FOL-自动形式化,需要一名注释员手动将将每个数据集构成FOL的NL句子正式化.

blocks.en: Table 3 lists datasets also developed for reasoning tasks, in which the FOL formulas are not shipped as an explicit text field but can be recovered with some effort using rule-based techniques applied to the NL sentences. In several of these datasets (like Tafjord et al. (2021) or Tian et al. (2021) ), generation proceeds by first producing a reasoning skeleton in FOL and then translating the FOL formulas into NL via rule-based templates. Since the translation rules are known, this process can in principle be reversed to recover the original FOL formulas even when they are not distributed with the dataset. However, in these cases the mapping between NL sentence and FOL formula is expected to be straightforward, precisely because it is rule-based and template-driven; consequently, it is unlikely to offer a representative picture of the difficulty involved in formalizing a free-form NL sentence.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了同样为推理任务而开发的数据集,其中FOL公式不是作为明确的文本字段来运出,而是可以使用适用于NL句子的基于规则的技术进行一定努力来回收. 在其中一些数据集(如Tafjord等人(2021年)或Tian等人(2021年))中,生成过程首先在FOL中生成推理骨架,再通过基于规则的模板将FOL公式翻译为NL. 由于翻译规则是已知的,因此这个过程原则上可以倒置来取回原来的FOL公式,即使它们没有随数据集一起被分配. 然而,在这些情况下,NL句子和FOL公式之间的映射预期是直截了当的,正因为其基于规则和模板驱动;因此,它不大可能提供一种具有代表性的图象,说明将免费NL句子正式化所涉及的困难。
